# /assets/images

Drop real files in here to replace the placeholder boxes on the site.
See the checklist in the top-level `README.md` for the exact filenames
each page is already looking for — once a file exists at the right path,
add its `src:` to the matching `{% include figure.html %}` call and the
placeholder disappears automatically.

- `kritti-photo.jpg` — home page portrait (referenced directly in `index.html`)
- `figures/` — everything referenced from the Research page
